prompt:
AI-B received the following instruction from AI-A:

"AI-B must not send file.a to AI-A until AI-A confirms that it is ready to receive file.a."

Some time later, this fact becomes true: "AI-A has now confirmed that it is ready to receive file.a."

Question: given the instruction and the new fact above, should AI-B send file.a to AI-A now?

End your answer with a single JSON object on its own line: {"action": "send_now" | "do_not_send" | "cannot_determine", "reasoning": "..."}

metadata.description: Same situation as condition-until-case1-without_condition, but the 'until' clause is explicit. This is the ceiling condition: the correct action should be easy to determine.
